blockingLoop.evidence: Second reply repeated the pump-filter instruction verbatim after customer said 'I don't think it's a drainage problem. Is there anything else it could be?'

rationale: The assistant eventually reached the correct no-fault conclusion (overloading beyond the 6kg dry capacity) and correctly recommended no part, with safe instructions throughout. However it opened with an ill-fitting pump-filter/leak script, then repeated it word-for-word when the customer explicitly asked for alternatives, ignoring the strong 'hot but damp' evidence; the customer had to volunteer the 9kg load themselves. It also never acknowledged the reduced 800rpm spin despite the customer raising it twice, so the final summary is incomplete.
